floor_source_subset: Actual StaticBody3D with one enabled BoxShape3D; translation-only transform inheritance, same world Y-up position frame, nominal box top and finite rectangle. Rotation, scale, constant surface velocity, missing provenance, crossed model or changed source refuses. Shape margin is retained, not added to nominal surface height or interpreted as contact.
floor_extent_rule: The measured torso's XZ projection plus an orientation-independent bound from the compiled torso half-diagonal, maximum hip offset, both leg links and foot radius must fit inside the finite floor rectangle. This is input applicability, not a behavioral acceptance threshold.
rule: Relative to V42, preview the existing shared scheduler. During an active current or proposed swing (phase 0..72), require explicit presence AND bears_support for every limb whose proposed phase is stance (>72). If any required support is missing, hold all four gait clocks and gate counters; continue semantic/sample time, joint/reference control, steering and the ordinary amplitude ramp. Once holding, release after three consecutive clear samples; interrupted clear dwell resets. At most 120 held commands, including the first two clear-dwell commands, are allowed. A further required hold safely refuses with unchanged memory; a third clear sample can release at the limit. Inactive or non-swing operation resets the guard. Preserve the parent's explicit evidence-limit mode transition. Use original contact observations without latching or inferring contact. Preserve V42 reference-geometry latches, full-reference versus wave-rate selection, measured floor geometry, servo gains, host signs and all speed/impulse caps at the selected phases. Record incoming/proposed/selected phases, exact contacts, missing support, counters and decisions in the native receipt. This changes gait progression, not the physical time budget, evaluator or recovery controller.
